grammar_title: -ing 与不定式作宾语(动词后接 doing / to do 的辨析)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第一册 Unit 2 Using language:-ing 与不定式作宾语。句子地道、坚持/成功主题;每题主句动词决定唯一正确的非谓语形式,干扰项为错误的非谓语/谓语形式;零术语,纯应用型。

points.point: 后接动名词作宾语的动词(enjoy/finish/avoid/mind/practise/suggest/consider 等)
points.overview: enjoy、finish、avoid、mind、practise、suggest、consider、admit、keep、give up、miss、imagine、deny、put off、can't help、feel like、be busy 等后面只能接 doing 作宾语,不能接 to do。

points.point: 后接不定式作宾语的动词(decide/hope/agree/promise/manage/offer/refuse 等)
points.overview: decide、hope、agree、promise、manage、offer、refuse、want、learn、fail、choose、plan、expect、wish、afford、pretend、prepare、seem、happen、aim 等后面只能接 to do 作宾语,不能接 doing。

points.point: 接 doing 与 to do 意义不同的动词(remember/forget/regret/stop/try/mean)
points.overview: remember/forget/regret + to do 指'去做(未做)'、+ doing 指'做过(已做)';stop to do '停下来去做'、stop doing '停止做';try to do '设法'、try doing '试着';mean to do '打算'、mean doing '意味着'。靠句子语境判断。

questions.stem: Even now, Liu Wei still enjoys ____ music to his many fans.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词作宾语 → playing。

questions.stem: She did not rest until she had finished ____ the whole novel.
questions.explanation: finish 后只能接动名词 → reading。

questions.stem: Good writers cannot always avoid ____ mistakes in their early drafts.
questions.explanation: avoid 后接动名词 → making。

questions.stem: Would you mind ____ a little longer for the results of the contest?
questions.explanation: mind 后接动名词 → waiting。

questions.stem: He practises ____ English aloud every single morning.
questions.explanation: practise 后接动名词 → speaking。

questions.stem: My teacher suggested ____ a different ending for my story.
questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词 → trying。

questions.stem: After school, she seriously considered ____ literature at university.
questions.explanation: consider 后接动名词 → studying。

questions.stem: He admitted ____ very nervous before the writing contest.
questions.explanation: admit 后接动名词 → feeling。

questions.stem: She kept ____ until every single publisher had answered her.
questions.explanation: keep 后接动名词 → trying。

questions.stem: Even during the war, he never gave up ____ on the novel.
questions.explanation: give up 后接动名词 → working。

questions.stem: She missed ____ her old writing group after she moved away.
questions.explanation: miss 后接动名词 → meeting。

questions.stem: Few people imagine ____ famous after so many rejections.
questions.explanation: imagine 后接动名词 → becoming。

questions.stem: The young poet firmly denied ____ anyone else's work.
questions.explanation: deny 后接动名词 → copying。

questions.stem: Don't put off ____ your story to the magazine any longer.
questions.explanation: put off(推迟)后接动名词 → sending。

questions.stem: We can't help ____ writers who never give in to failure.
questions.explanation: can't help(禁不住)后接动名词 → admiring。

questions.stem: Sometimes she felt like ____ up, but in the end she carried on.
questions.explanation: feel like 后接动名词 → giving。

questions.stem: He was busy ____ for the speech contest the whole week.
questions.explanation: be busy 后接动名词 → preparing。

questions.stem: The blind writer enjoyed ____ to the songs of the birds.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词 → listening。

questions.stem: She practises ____ a little every day to improve her calligraphy.
questions.explanation: practise 后接动名词 → drawing。

questions.stem: After ____ the last page, the tired editor finally smiled.
questions.explanation: 介词 after 后接动名词 → correcting。

questions.stem: After many rejections, she decided ____ writing in her own way.
questions.explanation: decide 后接不定式作宾语 → to keep。

questions.stem: The young author hoped ____ a friendly publisher one day.
questions.explanation: hope 后接不定式 → to find。

questions.stem: At last one publisher agreed ____ five hundred copies of her book.
questions.explanation: agree 后接不定式 → to print。

questions.stem: He promised ____ the novel even while serving in the army.
questions.explanation: promise 后接不定式 → to finish。

questions.stem: She finally managed ____ her first book at the age of thirty.
questions.explanation: manage 后接不定式 → to publish。

questions.stem: A kind editor offered ____ her with the most difficult chapter.
questions.explanation: offer 后接不定式 → to help。

questions.stem: Despite all the criticism, Salinger refused ____ up on his book.
questions.explanation: refuse 后接不定式 → to give。

questions.stem: After his accident, Liu Wei still wanted ____ life to the full.
questions.explanation: want 后接不定式 → to live。

questions.stem: He learned ____ his feet for everyday activities such as eating.
questions.explanation: learn 后接不定式 → to use。

questions.stem: On the fourth day he was so tired that he failed ____ out of bed.
questions.explanation: fail 后接不定式 → to get。

questions.stem: Many students choose ____ a summer camp to build their character.
questions.explanation: choose 后接不定式 → to take。

questions.stem: As a child, she already planned ____ a story about a young wizard.
questions.explanation: plan 后接不定式 → to write。

questions.stem: No one expected the shy boy ____ such a confident speaker.
questions.explanation: expect sb 后接不定式 → to become。

questions.stem: The three sisters only wished ____ their words in print.
questions.explanation: wish 后接不定式 → to see。

questions.stem: She could not afford ____ her own poetry published.
questions.explanation: afford 后接不定式 → to have。

questions.stem: He pretended ____ calm, though his heart was beating fast.
questions.explanation: pretend 后接不定式 → to stay。

questions.stem: The whole team prepared ____ in the school debate that afternoon.
questions.explanation: prepare 后接不定式 → to compete。

questions.stem: After years of effort, her hard work seemed ____ off at last.
questions.explanation: seem 后接不定式 → to pay。

questions.stem: I happened ____ her lost manuscript in an old wooden desk.
questions.explanation: happen 后接不定式 → to find。

questions.stem: Many campers aim ____ stronger and braver day by day.
questions.explanation: aim 后接不定式 → to grow。

questions.stem: Remember ____ the library books tomorrow; don't leave them at home.
questions.explanation: remember to do 指'记得去做(未做)';句中是明天该做的事 → to return。

questions.stem: I still clearly remember ____ my very first rejection letter years ago.
questions.explanation: remember doing 指'记得做过';是多年前发生的事 → receiving。

questions.stem: She fondly remembers ____ the prize on that happy spring day.
questions.explanation: remember doing 指'记得做过';那天获奖已发生 → winning。

questions.stem: Don't forget ____ your dad tonight; he is waiting for your news.
questions.explanation: forget to do 指'忘记去做(还没做)';今晚要打的电话 → to phone。

questions.stem: I will never forget ____ on that big stage for the very first time.
questions.explanation: forget doing 指'忘不了做过的事';第一次登台已发生 → standing。

questions.stem: He forgot ____ the window, so the cold wind blew in all night.
questions.explanation: forget to do 指'忘记去做';他没关窗 → to close。

questions.stem: "We regret ____ you that your story has not been chosen this time."
questions.explanation: regret to do 指'遗憾地(现在)去做';常用于通知 → to inform。

questions.stem: She has never regretted ____ so many weekends to her writing.
questions.explanation: regret doing 指'后悔做过';是过去付出的事 → giving。

questions.stem: He later regretted ____ so rudely to the kind old editor.
questions.explanation: regret doing 指'后悔做过';无礼说话已发生 → speaking。

questions.stem: On the fourth day he was so tired that he stopped ____ for a rest.
questions.explanation: stop to do 指'停下来去做另一件事';停下来休息 → to rest。

questions.stem: When his health failed, Liu Wei had to stop ____ in competitions.
questions.explanation: stop doing 指'停止做某事';不再参加游泳 → swimming。

questions.stem: Even when only two copies sold, the sisters never stopped ____.
questions.explanation: stop doing 指'停止做某事';她们不曾停止相信 → believing。

questions.stem: If the first plan does not work, try ____ a completely new ending.
questions.explanation: try doing 指'试着做(看效果)';换种写法试试 → writing。

questions.stem: She tried hard ____ the whole race, but it was simply too long.
questions.explanation: try to do 指'努力去做';她竭力想跑完 → to finish。

questions.stem: Whenever you feel low, try ____ on the bright side of things.
questions.explanation: try doing 指'试着做(一种方法)';试着往好处看 → looking。

questions.stem: Real success means ____ on even after many painful failures.
questions.explanation: mean doing 指'意味着';成功意味着坚持下去 → carrying。

questions.stem: He meant ____ his parents proud, so he kept practising every day.
questions.explanation: mean to do 指'打算';他打算让父母骄傲 → to make。

questions.stem: I'm sorry — I didn't mean ____ you; I only wanted to help.
questions.explanation: mean to do 指'有意(打算)';我并非有意让你难过 → to upset。

questions.stem: Please remember ____ off the lights before the show finally ends.
questions.explanation: remember to do 指'记得去做';演出结束前要关灯 → to turn。

questions.stem: She stopped ____ to the music and picked up her pen to write.
questions.explanation: stop doing 指'停止做某事';她不再听音乐 → listening。
